about: The animals' Blender build (D-326; tools/blender/animals.mjs). Per size class: cell = [dense source, base surface] marching-cubes cells (m; the dense one fine enough to carry the fleece's locks and the hair's streaks into the maps, the base fine enough for the thinnest part the levels keep: the ears, the fowl's toes); tris = [lod0, lod1] triangle targets (BLENDER_PLAN row 4: 3-6 k at LOD0; the fowl and the hare, 0.4-0.5 m long and drawn by the hundred in the yards, 1.6 k: C); tex = map size (px; about 3-5 mm per texel on each body); lod1 = the distance (m) beyond which lod1 is drawn, per metre of body length (C: where a lod0 triangle falls under ~2 px at the player's lens). Every species of src/people/animals.ts SPECIES is listed (tests/animal_models.test.ts).
